summary: Iteration 5 backend-only testing of the company-code normalization bugfix (slugify parity between setup-company, company-login and lookup-company). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py (23 tests): 22 passed, 1 failed (minor info-leak edge case in lookup-company). The reported user bug is FIXED: company-login now slugifies the input, so 'Gestor360', 'GESTOR360', ' gestor360 ' all authenticate against stored code 'gestor360'; 'Equipe Kirius' / 'EQUIPE KIRIUS' / 'equipe kirius' all resolve to 'equipe-kirius'. Setup+login round-trip with spaces ('Neto Materiais' -> 'neto-materiais') and with accents ('Néto Açaí') works when logging in with the RAW string. Also re-ran the full iteration4 regression suite: 41/41 passed (after fixing its credential-parsing regex which caused a module-level collection error).

minor.issue: Codes that slugify to an empty string ('   ', '!!!', '---', '@@@') match the pending-setup company stored with code='' and return {found: true, name: 'Test User — Empresa', code: ''}. This leaks another tenant's company name and shows a bogus 'company found' state in the two-step login UI. Fix: if slugify(code) is empty (or len < 3), return {found: false} immediately; likewise guard company_login (currently it only 401s incidentally because password_hash is '').

slugify() replaces accented chars with '-' instead of transliterating, so 'Néto Açaí' becomes 'n-to-a-a' and 'Gestão' becomes 'gest-o'. Login parity still holds (both sides slugify), but the generated code shown to the user is ugly/confusing. Recommend unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', ...) ASCII-folding before the regex so 'Néto Açaí' -> 'neto-acai'.

By design 'gestor 360' -> 'gestor-360' (space becomes '-') and returns 401 since only 'gestor360' exists. Confirmed per spec, but note this remains a foot-gun: users who created a code without spaces but type it with a space still get 'Empresa não encontrada'. Consider also trying a space-stripped fallback lookup, or show the normalized code in the setup confirmation screen.

action_items: Guard lookup-company (and company-login) against codes that slugify to '' so pending-setup companies with code='' are never matched — return {found: false} / 401.
Optional: ASCII-fold accents in slugify() so 'Néto Açaí' -> 'neto-acai' instead of 'n-to-a-a'.
Optional UX: after setup-company, surface the normalized code returned by the API ('code' field) to the owner so they know exactly what to type at login.
critical_code_review_comments: slugify() is now correctly used at all three call sites (setup_company L445, company_login L358, lookup_company L468) — parity confirmed.

companies documents created by /auth/register and /auth/session use code='' as a sentinel; any query keyed on a normalized code must explicitly reject empty codes (root cause of the lookup-company leak).
/app/backend/server.py is 1179 lines — consider splitting auth, documents and PDF generation into separate modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: setup-company stored slugify(code) while company-login only did lower().strip(), so a code entered as 'Equipe Kirius' was stored as 'equipe-kirius' but looked up as 'equipe kirius' -> 401 'Empresa não encontrada ou senha inválida'. Fix (slugify at company_login + lookup_company) verified working for all case/space/whitespace variants. Residual defect: slugify('') / slugify('!!!') == '' collides with the code='' sentinel used for pending-setup companies, so lookup-company reports found=true for garbage input.
